motions.item_title: Appoint Joshua Biagio to the Library Advisory Board, completing a term through December 2025
motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to appoint Joshua Biagio to the Library Advisory Board, completing a term through December 2025. Councilmember Gray seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Joshua Biagio appointed to Library Advisory Board
motions.summary: The council appointed Joshua Biagio to the Library Advisory Board, finishing a term that runs through December 2025.
motions.impact: Nothing changes day to day — this fills an unexpired seat on a board that advises the city on the library.

motions.motion: Councilmember Gray moved to approve the Consent Agenda. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Consent agenda approved
motions.summary: The council passed its consent agenda as a single batch; the record does not list which items were included.
motions.impact: Consent items are the routine business the council approves together without separate debate. The record here doesn't say what was in this batch.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Proposal for the Creation of a New School District, Pursuant to Utah Code 53G-3-301.4, Scheduling Final Action on the Creation of a New School District, and Related Matters. This item was presented prior to the Consent Agenda.
motions.motion: Councilmember Gray moved to adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving an Amendment to the Adobe Value Incentive Plan Terms and Conditions. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
motions.headline: New school district proposal approved
motions.summary: The council approved the proposal to create a new school district and set the date for its final decision on it.
motions.impact: This advances the proposal rather than settling it — a final council vote is still to come. If a new district is created, it would change which school district Eagle Mountain belongs to.
